inventory.title: list_followups — cross-plan unresolved followup scanner
inventory.summary: New store fn list_followups_across(project, unresolved_only=True) scans all *.json in state dir, skips index.json and project.json. MCP tool _list_followups returns {project, count, followups[{slug, followup_id, title, blocked_by, tier, written_at}]}. Closes the highest-cost gap: today required 7 serial read_plan calls to find 7 followups.

inventory.title: list_questions — cross-plan open question scanner
inventory.summary: New store fn list_questions_across(project, open_only=True) + MCP tool _list_questions. Returns {project, count, questions[{slug, question_id, section, body, opened_by, opened_at}]}. Questions are currently buried per-plan with no cross-plan view. Pairs with mcp-resolve-question.

inventory.title: resolve_question — close a question with resolution text
inventory.summary: MCP tool _resolve_question(project, slug, question_id, resolution, by, expected_version). Sets resolved_at, resolved_by, resolution. Thin wrapper over resolve_in_list(..., 'questions', ...) — no new store fn. New Pydantic model ResolveQuestionArgs. Today only raw patch_plan works.

inventory.title: add_research — append a structured research item
inventory.summary: MCP tool _add_research(project, slug, item, expected_version). Required fields: id, type, title, source, added_by, when. Optional: url. Valid types: paper|doc|web|dataset|thread|image|plan. Validates required fields before append. New Pydantic model AddResearchArgs.

inventory.title: list_projects — discover registered projects from mounts.json
inventory.summary: MCP tool _list_projects() — zero parameters. Reads ~/docs-server/mounts.json, cross-references state root for index.json presence. Returns {projects: [{project, path, has_index}]}. Critical for fresh sessions: without this, agents must know project names before calling any other tool.

inventory.title: list_plans discovery fallback for per-doc repos
inventory.summary: Update _list_plans in mcp.py to fall back to discover_plans() from serve.py when index.json has no inventory. Discovers plans from HTML <meta name="plan-status"> tags. Errors silently swallowed — discovery is best-effort. Makes MCP useful for repos without a central-index layout.

inventory.title: append_comment — collision-resistant note ID
inventory.summary: One-line fix in mcp.py: replace f'n{len(notes)+1}' with f'n-{datetime.now(tz=timezone.utc):%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%f}'. Timestamp IDs are sortable, human-readable, and collision-resistant to microsecond. Fixes silent data corruption when notes are deleted or concurrent agents append.

inventory.title: test_mcp_tools.py — MCP tool layer test coverage
inventory.summary: New tests/test_mcp_tools.py covering all 5 new tools + note-ID fix + discovery fallback. Target: ≥25 cases passing in <0.5s. Uses same state_root fixture pattern as test_mcp_store.py. _list_projects needs monkeypatch of Path.home() to serve a synthetic mounts.json. list_plans discovery fallback needs a minimal HTML fixture with plan-status meta tag. Zero tests cover the MCP tool layer today.

inventory.title: MCP gap-closure — power-user queries
inventory.summary: Reference document for all 8 S4 items. Detailed implementation spec per section: code signatures, data shapes, test cases. Source at docs/reckon-mcp-gaps.html.

sprints.description: Close 7 gaps confirmed in the 2026-05-26 tool evaluation: 5 missing query tools, a list_plans discovery fallback for per-doc repos, and a note-ID collision fix. Add test coverage for the MCP tool layer.
sprints.summary: 7 serial read_plan calls to find 7 followups — that was the productivity tax today. S4 eliminates it: list_followups and list_questions give cross-plan views in one call. list_projects unlocks fresh sessions. resolve_question and add_research give structured write paths for the two remaining unstructured operations. The discovery fallback makes MCP work for per-doc repos without a central index.json. The note-ID fix closes a silent corruption bug. tests/test_mcp_tools.py covers the tool layer (zero coverage today).

items.justification: Fresh sessions need project discovery before anything else — currently blocked entirely without knowing project names a priori.
7 serial reads to find 7 followups in today's session. Single highest-ROI fix.
Open questions buried per-plan, no cross-plan view. Pairs with resolve_question to close the Q&A lifecycle.
Questions have no dedicated close path today; raw patch_plan with full array is the only option.
Research items require read + full-array patch today. Structured validated append is safer and cheaper.
Per-doc repos (no central index.json) return zero plans from list_plans today. Fallback makes the tool universal.
len(notes)+1 collides when notes are deleted or concurrent agents append — silent data corruption.
Zero tests cover the MCP tool layer today. Required quality gate before any of the 7 fixes ship.
